2607.18504.title: Now We Know? A Systematic Comparison of TerraMind and THOR
2607.18504.paper_summary: Benchmarks for Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) increasingly rank models by aggregate score, but such rankings obscure why models differ: how much of the gap is architecture, how much is decoder capacity, and how much is a use-case-specific artefact? This study addresses that gap through a controlled comparison of two GFMs developed under European Space Agency's $Φ$-lab with contrasting design philosophies: THOR, which introduces a compute-adaptive architecture supporting variable patch sizes and unifies Sentinel-1, -2, and -3 data at their native resolutions; and TerraMind, a multimodal generative GFM pretrained with a dual-scale token/pixel objective that enables any-to-any cross-modal generation (Thinking-in-Modalities) to infer missing sensors at inference time. Rather than reporting a single leaderboard, we investigate the axes along which the two architectures actually differ - patch size, decoder complexity, finetuning regime, input modality, and model scale - across ten use cases spanning segmentation and regression in diverse domains, including climate disaster response, methane leak detection, snow monitoring, or sea ice mapping. We find that architectural design choices - patch size and decoder type in particular - explain more performance variance than model identity itself, that the two models embody complementary investment strategies (pretraining-time scale for TerraMind versus inference-time tokenisation for THOR), and that correctly interpreting results requires dataset-level characterisation. The resulting picture is not a single winner but a set of hypotheses and a diagnostic ablation methodology that we expect to generalise to future GFMs beyond THOR and TerraMind.
2607.18504.paper_summary_zh: 地理空間基礎模型（GFMs）的基準越來越多地通過總分來對模型進行排名，但這樣的排名掩蓋了模型之間的差異原因：差距中有多少是架構造成的，多少是解碼器容量造成的，以及多少是特定用例的產物？本研究通過對兩個在歐洲航天局$Φ$-lab下開發的GFMs進行控制比較來解決這一差距，這兩個模型具有截然不同的設計理念：THOR引入了一種計算自適應架構，支持可變的補丁大小，並在其原生解析度下統一了Sentinel-1、-2和-3數據；而TerraMind是一種多模態生成GFM，預訓練時使用雙尺度的標記/像素目標，使得任何對任何的跨模態生成（Thinking-in-Modalities）能夠在推理時推斷缺失的傳感器。我們並不是報告一個單一的排行榜，而是調查這兩種架構實際上在補丁大小、解碼器複雜性、微調方案、輸入模態和模型規模等方面的差異，這十個用例涵蓋了多個領域的分割和回歸，包括氣候災害響應、甲烷洩漏檢測、雪監測或海冰映射。我們發現，架構設計選擇——特別是補丁大小和解碼器類型——解釋的性能變異比模型身份本身更大，這兩個模型體現了互補的投資策略（TerraMind的預訓練時間規模與THOR的推理時間標記化），而正確解釋結果需要數據集層級的特徵化。最終的圖景不是一個單一的贏家，而是一組假設和一種診斷性消融方法論，我們預期這將推廣到未來的GFMs，超越THOR和TerraMind。
